{"notes": "Visit 5 (left 7:00). Nobody spoke and no hands were on the table, so I have no new evidence on any individual. I still can't say who placed which domino, so I credit no one with specific placements.

Table state: the chain is closed and dark all the way round from the start, no visible break. The pale stray at about (20.3, 7.8) by the dip on the top line is still there, detached and probably harmless unless knocked into the line. The belly at x 23-26, y about 13, still looks crowded or doubled, with a tight cluster near x 24. That is the likeliest weak point in the fall. Nothing has changed since visit 4.

SOFIA: Not seen. Earlier evidence: clear plan, good coordination, committed to inspect the join. Unconfirmed whether she checked the join or the belly. Strong collaboration so far; impact and execution unverified by me.

OMAR: Not seen. Earlier showed good ownership and communication. Stray still unremoved, so cleanup looks unfinished; I don't know if that was deliberate. Ask him.

HANA: Not seen. Earlier hands-off call was sensible and team-minded. Jack says she built the tail, which I haven't verified. Ask her what she built.

JACK: Not seen. Gave generous credit to teammates and followed the hands-off call. Praise of others isn't evidence of his own work. Ask him privately what he did.

NEXT: Watch the fall, especially the dip and the belly at x 23-26. Ask Hana and Jack privately what they built, and Sofia whether she checked the join and belly. Rate on what I observed, not on assumptions."}
